title: Offering Circular, Purchase Limit Section — Excess of a Class H Preferred Stock Purchase over the Quarter's Purchase Allowance, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
A Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock purchase is held to the quarter's purchase allowance; the part above it is the quarter-limit excess.

## Terms

1. **Quarter-limit excess**: the amount counted against the quarter less the quarter's purchase allowance, never below zero, to the cent.
2. **Amount counted against the quarter**: the latest purchase alone — the purchase entry with the latest effective date on the holding.
3. **Quarter's purchase allowance**: the class's most preferred stock a member may buy in one calendar quarter (USD 250000 for Class H Preferred Stock in the summary of dividend and preferred purchase terms).

## Worked figures (hypothetical latest purchases)

| Latest purchase | Purchase allowance | Quarter-limit excess |
|---|---|---|
| 262,500.00 | 250,000.00 | 12,500.00 |
| 250,000.00 | 250,000.00 | 0.00 — exactly at the allowance |
| 250,000.01 | 250,000.00 | 0.01 |
| 240,000.00 | 250,000.00 | 0.00 |
